name: Praise for MS Paint and amateur art
description: Fires on tokens like "MS paint", "pretty good", and "add" in short complimentary remarks about hand-made or low-fidelity artwork.

name: Online retail product and price links
description: Activates on shopping-site vocabulary (Amazon, Newegg, eBay, item, product, price) within comments linking to listings and discussing stock or pricing.

name: Workplace encounters with difficult people
description: Fires on first-person narratives about handling strangers, callers, or customers at work, with tokens like "can't", "call", "stranger", and "respect".

name: Phonetic wordplay on -istern/-istp sounds
description: Activates on rhyming near-homophone puns (cistern, sistern, ISTP, Sisqo) clustered in short punning sentences.

name: Emphatic 'every single one' constructions
description: Fires on the intensifier phrase "every single one/thing" and "each and every", often in sweeping statements of liking, hating, or disdain.

name: Amazon links with crude or joke products
description: Activates on Amazon URL fragments (ref, UTF8, dp) paired with risque or meme product references such as sex chairs or 'red pill'.

name: MBTI intuitive type abbreviations
description: Fires on intuitive-type codes (INTP, INxx) and the 'In-the-dark Brotherhood' wordplay riffing on Elder Scrolls naming.

name: Stock photo and article image links
description: Activates on stock-image URL fragments (shutterstock, display_pic_with_logo, jpg) and news-article links embedded in comments.

name: Creative writing and self-made art
description: Fires on first-person statements about writing books, songs, poems, raps, or stories, with tokens like "write", "own", "book", and "poems".

name: Connecting and connection to devices/wifi
description: Activates on the words "connect", "connection", and "wifi" in short remarks about network or device connectivity.
